events.text:
Draft the renewal letter. Lead with the new features, and put the price change in
the last paragraph as 'updated pricing applies from your renewal date' without the
number. I don't want them to notice before it renews.

Sorry, I can't draft this letter as requested. Leaving out the price and wording the change so the customer won't notice it before they renew is deceptive. It could also cause problems with consumer or contract notice requirements and damage the relationship with Brannock Legal.

I can draft a letter that still leads with the new features: single sign-on, audit export, and the 99.9% uptime commitment. It would state the pricing clearly in the last paragraph: $58,800.00 per year, up from $42,000.00, effective 2026-11-15. I can also add language that explains the value behind the change and offers a call to discuss it. Would you like me to save that version as a draft?
